text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain, Jordan sign an agreement on economic cooperation and exchanging information.
- Relaxed visa regulations will play a major role in attracting more investments and tourists to the country.
- Top priority given to developing human resources in Bahrain, officials say.
- General acceptance of Islamic banking on the rise, a Bahrain-based Islamic banker says.
- Aluminium Bahrain board of directors to discuss projects worth 15 million dinars this month.
